Since 2021, my beloved rabbit had been receiving excellent care at this clinic for repeated stasis and malocclusion.

Sadly, she crossed the rainbow bridge the other day, and I'm in the midst of pet loss. Last night, I was surprised to find flowers from the clinic waiting for me when I got home.

I had been regretting that I couldn't do more as her owner, so the flowers were a great comfort.

I'm incredibly grateful to the doctor, receptionists, and nurses for their consistently kind and helpful service.

I've been raising rabbits for over thirty years, but there aren't as many veterinarians who treat rabbits as I've been turned away by local clinics, so having access to this clinic by bus was a great relief.

Thank you so much for everything.

Thank you for using our services and for providing us with your feedback.

We take your feedback very seriously and will continue to strive to be a veterinary hospital that you can use with peace of mind.

Gaia Animal Hospital
Director: Matsuda

Thank you very much for your kind and high rating.

We are encouraged by your positive feedback and will continue to strive for excellence.

We will continue to work hard to be a veterinary hospital that you can use with confidence.

Clinic Director, Matsuda

I used their pet hotel service. They sent me a message via LINE, not by phone, regarding a mistake made by the hospital during my pet's stay. I replied to that message, but received no response, and I received no other communication during the entire stay. I was very worried.

The photos they sent of my pet on a walk showed the harness improperly fitted; its legs were in the wrong places, which was very upsetting.

My pet apparently vomited during its stay, but when I went to pick it up, they said they wanted to tell me about the illness first, which made me even more anxious. I wanted to know why they hadn't responded to my message about the mistake they unilaterally sent during the stay, but they didn't explain that and instead just explained the illness.

(I took my pet to my usual vet, and it wasn't the illness they described, and it hasn't vomited since returning home.)

When I dropped my pet off, they asked if I had any other concerns, which I did. When I went to pick it up and check if everything was alright, the head veterinarian said they didn't know anything beyond what was written on paper, and later admitted they hadn't even taken any notes. I thought that was irresponsible.


I asked if they could send me a letter explaining my pet's illness, but for some reason, they refused.

Later, I received a phone call from the head veterinarian apologizing and explaining, but even then, he laughed several times during the conversation. I felt sad because it didn't seem like they were genuinely caring about the animals or their owners.

They never explained why they couldn't send a letter.

I found it a little unsettling that they were laughing during the phone call.

When I asked if they could explain the situation directly instead of over the phone, they said, "We're in the middle of seeing patients right now, so that's not possible." They added, "You can find out our clinic hours if you look them up, can't you?" I was confused why they wouldn't explain directly, and my distrust only increased.

I was also shocked when they asked, "Besides an apology, what else would you like?"

They said this with a slight laugh.

I think they should be more empathetic towards my beloved pet. I received an apology, so that's good, but more than the staff member who made the mistake, I was disappointed by the director's lack of sincerity, and I'm a little scared of having entrusted my pet to them.

In the end, I'm so glad my pet was returned safely this time. Thank you to everyone who took care of it.

The new staff member with the beginner's mark and the doctor who examined my pet's feet before (I'm not sure if they're still there) were very helpful.

I understand from the phone call that they no longer care, so I don't want a reply.

Thank you very much for your kind review.

We are encouraged by your feedback and will continue to strive to provide even better medical care.

We look forward to your continued patronage.

Clinic Director, Matsuda

My beloved 18-year-old cat was cared for at this clinic from August 2nd, 2026 to April 14th, 2026.

I am truly grateful to Dr. Sasamura, who was in charge of her care.

Thank you so much to the director and all the staff.

Thank you very much for your kind feedback.

We will use your positive evaluation as encouragement to strive to provide even better medical care.

We look forward to your continued support.

Clinic Director, Matsuda

Thank you so much for your kind words.

It is a great encouragement to all of our staff.

We will continue to strive to be a hospital where everyone can visit with peace of mind.

Thank you for your continued support.

Hospital Director, Matsuda

I chose this hospital because it's close to my home, and it's a very clean and pleasant hospital.

The doctor is very caring and examines my cat carefully, and the receptionists and nurses are also very kind. They handled my feisty cat calmly, and I felt completely at ease leaving my cat in their care. 🐱

They also share information on their blog and social media, and I felt they were a very dedicated and trustworthy doctor. I'm so relieved to have this hospital in my neighborhood!
